asset.description: The Airflow asset the event was registered for: id, name, uri, group and extra. The id is null on Airflow versions that do not pass it to listeners.

assetEvent.description: The Airflow asset event: id, watcherName, triggerClasspath, extra (holding the trigger payload), partitionKey, partitionDate and sourceAliases. id, watcherName and triggerClasspath are null on Airflow versions that do not pass them to listeners.
